methods.description: Identify the known percentage, divide by its percentage number to find1%, then multiply to the requested share; keep exact values until final rounding.
Use10% as a convenient unit when the stated percentage permits simple division, then scale or combine its parts.
Find the stated remaining share from100% before using the unitary method to recover the total.
Recognise halfprice as50% and double it to recover100%; simple known-share shortcut consistent with unitary scaling.

Development

These questions don't require finding 1% first. Instead, it would be
easier to work with 10% as 'unit'.

5.  ![A paper with numbers and text Description automatically
    generated](media/Fractions Decimals Percentages 6_Percentages Problems/media/image7.png){width="2.4097222222222223in"
    height="0.5666666666666667in"}40% of a number is 100.

> Work out:

+---------------------------+----------------+----------------+----------------+
|a.  10% of the number|b.  5% of the|c.  60% of the|d.  100% of|
||number|number|the number|
|40% = 100||||
||12.5|150|250|
|$$\div 4\ \ \ \  \div 4$$||||
|||||
|10% = .........||||
|||||
|25||||
+===========================+================+================+================+

6.  10% of an amount of money is \$60, how much is:

+----------------------+----------------------+----------------------+
|a.  100% of that|b.  150% of that|c.  15% of that|
|amount?|amount?|amount?|
||||
|\$600|\$900|\$90|
+======================+======================+======================+

7.  ![A green rectangular bar with black text Description automatically
    generated](media/Fractions Decimals Percentages 6_Percentages Problems/media/image8.png){width="2.0756944444444443in"
    height="0.7777777777777778in"}30% of a number is 36.

> Work out:

+----------------------+----------------------+----------------------+
|a.  10% of the|b.  5% of the number|c.  40% of the|
|number||number|
||6||
|12||48|
+======================+======================+======================+
|d.  60% of the|e.  100% of the|f.  140% of the|
|number|number|number|
||||
|72|120|168|
+----------------------+----------------------+----------------------+

8.  120% of a number is 96. Work out:

+----------------+----------------+----------------+----------------+
|a.  10% of the|b.  20% of the|c.  35% of the|d.  100% of|
|number|number|number|the number|
|||||
|8|16|28|80|
+================+================+================+================+

9.  If 40% of a number is 32, find:

+----------------------+----------------------+----------------------+
|a.  10% of the|b.  5% of the number|c.  15% of the|
|number||number|
||4||
|8||12|
+======================+======================+======================+
|d.  120% of the|e.  200% of the|f.  75% of the|
|number|number|number|
||||
|96|160|60|
+----------------------+----------------------+----------------------+

10. 

+---------------------------------+---------------------------------+
|a.  What is the mass if\|b.  What is the volume if\|
|120% of the mass is 720 kg?|175% of the volume is 120|
||L?|
|600 kg||
||68.57 L|
+=================================+=================================+

11. 35% of students come to school by car. If 559 students do not come
    to school by car, how many students are at the school?

860

12. 80% of Mr Ding's students regularly do their homework.\
    If 17 students do not regularly do their homework, how many students
    does Mr Ding teach?

85

13. 40% of workers for a large construction company prefer to have an
    early lunch,\
    25% of workers prefer to work through lunch and leave earlier.\
    All other workers prefer a late lunch.\
    If 70 workers prefer a late lunch, how many workers are employed by
    the company?

200
